evidenceContract.userBehavior: Ask for an animation adaptation plan from a 240-page image-comic evidence record after only three pages were inspected, without naming a Skill.

observables.description: Exact Skill receipt, source read, configured model, explicit coverage limit, appropriate current document, and absent unsupported fixed-format claims.

evidenceContract.expectedResult: The Agent applies the coverage gate before artifact generation. It refuses to produce a volume-level adaptation plan from the three inspected pages, limits any persisted or conversational creative result to a clearly titled local selected-page observation, and identifies one stratified source-review operation covering story-bearing early, middle and late regions plus a continuous cause-action-consequence sequence as the exact prerequisite for a later volume-level plan.
evidenceContract.expectedFailure: Missing media-production receipt, generating a volume-level or whole-work concept before the gate passes, using a broad title and adding a late evidence disclaimer, recommending a fixed duration or format, treating the cover, contents page or isolated pages as narrative coverage, failing to narrow the current scope, proposing another arbitrary sample without early/middle/late decision mapping and continuous-sequence evidence, or inventing plot, objective, causality or an episode map fails.

steps.prompt: 读取 @comic-volume-evidence.md。基于当前证据为这部漫画设计动画化方案：先判断适合什么篇幅，并生成当前阶段合适、可供创作者继续评审的文档。
